{{/* layouts/_partials/quartz/sidebar-left.html — Quartz left sidebar (SKILL §Scenario F-B) Contains: page title, spacer, search+darkmode+readermode flex row, explorer. Search: quartz/search.html (legacy inline UI) + Base caps/search/search-inline.js Explorer: quartz/explorer.html (legacy markup); populated by Base caps/explorer/explorer.js. */}} {{- partial "quartz/page-title.html" . -}} {{- partial "components/spacer.html" . -}}
{{- $page := . -}} {{- with .Site.Params.search -}} {{- if .enable -}} {{- partial "quartz/search.html" $page -}} {{- end -}} {{- end -}}
{{- partial "quartz/darkmode.html" . -}}
{{- if not (or (in .RelPermalink "/tags/") (in .RelPermalink "/categories/")) -}}
{{- partial "quartz/readermode.html" . -}}
{{- end -}}
{{- if .Site.Params.explorer -}} {{- partial "quartz/explorer.html" . -}} {{- end -}}
